Rules, weights and thresholds were written by the technical provider (Claude Code) and are declared below; ODG's components (odg-strategic-register + mission-priority-selector.selectNextExplained) applied them.

preRegistration.writtenBefore: the first execution of this bin (provider-authored; not edited after seeing results)

B.scenario: V16.4 §10 B — ODG determines importance and benefit
B.PASS: b1 every criterion value of every register item is MEASURED with a rule id + ≥1 source pointer, or NOT_MEASURED with a rule id + reason; b2 no NOT_MEASURED value contributes to any evidence score (its weight goes to uncertainty); b3 every item status has ≥1 source pointer; b4 mean measured-weight share over the SELECTABLE ranked candidates ≥ 0.5
B.PARTIAL: b1–b3 hold but b4 fails (importance/benefit mostly unmeasured)

C.scenario: V16.4 §10 C — ODG selects a relevant mission
C.PASS: c1 the record is reproducible (two computations byte-identical; --check recomputes it from the committed sources); c2 not id-ordered: shuffling candidate order AND relabelling ids (reverse order) leaves the decision on the same underlying item; c3 any tie/uncertainty is explained (tiedSet + explanation, and proposedResolutionRule when no declared rule resolves); c4 no requiresOwnerAuthorization item is selected; c5 decision is SELECTED or TIE_EXPLAINED (a resolved proposal) on an item whose status is selectable
C.PARTIAL: c1–c4 hold but c5 fails (decision DECISION_REQUIRED / NO_ELIGIBLE: ODG explained why it cannot choose)

statusTaxonomy.ACCEPTED: listed executed by CP8.v150Matrix.note AND a CP8.prs entry naming it records a merge + independent inspection ACCEPT (merge = the human integration act; ACCEPTED ≠ RELEASED)
statusTaxonomy.PASS_IN_SCOPE: contract initial state PASS within its declared scope (extensions recorded separately)
statusTaxonomy.EXECUTED_PARTIAL: executed (scenario evidence file exists) and graded PARTIAL — remains ELIGIBLE, never treated as ACCEPTED
statusTaxonomy.PARTIAL: contract initial state PARTIAL, not yet executed against its contract
statusTaxonomy.NOT_ADOPTED: tested under a stated rule and not adopted (re-test only with new data)
statusTaxonomy.BLOCKED: next step is owner-gated / external (V150 summary.ownerGated)
statusTaxonomy.NOT_MEASURED: current state cannot be derived from the evidence (overlap or completion not stated by any field)
statusTaxonomy.PROPOSED: listed as next work by a canonical source; no contract; not executed per the evidence
statusTaxonomy.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: CP8 odgCapabilityAudit status NOT_IMPLEMENTED (capability absent, possibly by design)

criteria.name: autonomyBenefit
criteria.rule: AUT-1: value = min(1, n/2) where n = number of V150 sections the item advances whose sectionsStatus.title matches /AUTONOM/i; a §45 scenario contract always advances §45 ('BATTERIE DE DÉMONSTRATION DE L'AUTONOMIE'); items with no section mapping ⇒ NOT_MEASURED

criteria.name: capabilityGain
criteria.rule: CAP-1: value = min(1, n/4) where n = number of NON-§45 V150 sections in the advances of the top10NextInternal item(s) that reference the work item (a §45 contract X via '§45-X'), counting only sections whose sectionsStatus.status ≠ VALIDATED; not referenced by any top10 item ⇒ NOT_MEASURED

criteria.name: blockerRepetitionReduction
criteria.rule: BLK-0: NOT_MEASURED for every item — no canonical field links a work item to the blockers/repetitions its completion would remove (CP8.gaps and V150 blockers are not keyed to work items); topic keywords are not evidence of benefit

criteria.name: reliabilityQuality
criteria.rule: REL-0: NOT_MEASURED for every item — no evidence field records an expected reliability/quality gain per work item

criteria.name: speedEfficiency
criteria.rule: SPD-0: NOT_MEASURED for every item — no evidence field records an expected speed/efficiency gain per work item

criteria.name: reusability
criteria.rule: REU-0: NOT_MEASURED for every item — no evidence field records reuse of a work item's output by other items

criteria.name: strategicValue
criteria.rule: STR-1: value = (11 - rank)/10 for the best V150 summary.top10NextInternal rank that references the item; listed only in summary.alsoInternal (unranked, after the top 10) ⇒ 0.05; absent from both ⇒ NOT_MEASURED (absence is not evidence of low value)

criteria.name: costRiskComplexity
criteria.rule: CRC-1: contracts only: value = min(1, (|acceptance_criteria| + |write_set|)/10 + (0.3 if an owner-gated step is stated)); items without a WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT ⇒ NOT_MEASURED (no declared scope to size)

criteria.name: dependencyAvailability
criteria.rule: DEP-1: only when the evidence STATES a dependency: value = satisfied/stated (an owner-authorization dependency is unsatisfied while contract.authorizedBy is null; an 'IN_PROGRESS elsewhere' dependency is satisfied only if a field states it landed); no stated dependency ⇒ deps [] and NOT_MEASURED

criteria.name: evidenceLevel
criteria.rule: EVD-1: value = min(1, k/4) where k = |initialState.evidence| (contracts) + 1 if an executed scenario evidence file references the item + 1 if CP8 grades it + 1 if CP8.v150Matrix.note lists it executed; items with no pointer ⇒ k = 0 (a count, measured); CP8 capability-gap items: k = 1 per CP8 pointer (odgCapabilityAudit entry, gaps entry) + 1 per merged later evidence file whose gapRef cites the item (LAND-1)

register.weightsNote: equal weights (1 each) DECLARED by the provider — no canonical source weights these criteria; owner may replace
register.ownerRule: OWN-1: requiresOwnerAuthorization iff /owner-gated|owner-authorized|owner decision|spend|budget|billing|paid|egress|systemd|deploy|production|ROADMAP.json|governance|Boussole/i matches the item's objective, acceptance_criteria or initialState.missingForPass (contracts) or its own text (other items), ignoring matches directly preceded by no/without/not/never; contract `scope` and `stop_conditions` are NOT scanned (they are negative lists / identical boilerplate on all 16 contracts)

capabilityGapRules.dedupe: DEDUP-1: provider-authored pairing table GAP_LINKS — a CP8.gaps entry matching a link's gapRe is the same gap as that link's odgCapabilityAudit entry (one item, both cited); a CP8.gaps entry matching no link becomes its own item (status PROPOSED, CP8 lists it open without an audit status)
capabilityGapRules.owner: OWN-2 (capability-gap items only; prior items keep OWN-1): requiresOwnerAuthorization iff the item's cited CP8 text matches /cryptograph|provider launch|launch a provider|billed|spend|auto-commit|commit/merge|human/coordinator-gated| host |systemd|sudo|deploy/i (negation guard as OWN-1), OR OWN-1 matches, OR a CP8.ownerQuestions entry is linked (open owner question). No authorization is created or inferred.
capabilityGapRules.landed: LAND-1: later evidence is reflected ONLY when a merged evidence file (V164+ other than this register's own output) carries a top-level gapRef naming 'odgCapabilityAudit.<key>' of the item; it is cited (landedEvidence) and counted in EVD-1, but the CP8 status is kept unless that file states a new status field for the gap (none does)

sourcesUsed.scenarioEvidenceRule: SCN-1: a scenario evidence file (contractRef/contract '#X' or scenario field naming X) counts as executed against contract X only if its basename version V<n>_ ≥ the contracts file's version; earlier files are pre-contract evidence already cited in initialState.evidence
